bagPolicy.summary: Only clutches, wristlets and fanny packs up to 4" x 6" x 1.5" are allowed. Purses and backpacks are not permitted.
allowed: Fanny packs up to 4" x 6" x 1.5"
Medical and diaper bags up to 14" x 14" x 6"
prohibited: Hard case containers such as coolers
Water bottles at concerts, including empty ones
bagPolicy.note: Medical and diaper bags are inspected and x-rayed at designated entrances. The policies FAQ lists Binbox bag lockers in the Grand Atrium plaza from $15 per bag (card or mobile pay only), opening 30 minutes before doors, with no access during the event. Bag rules can vary for concerts and special events.

parking.note: Ball Arena offers several parking lots with varying prices depending on the event. Parking lots open 3 hours before events, and credit/debit cards are accepted at all lots. The Tundra lot offers a $5 discount for card payments.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Ball Arena's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: Ball Arena offers a diverse range of food and drink options, including craft beers, cocktails, and a variety of hot entrees. Highlights include Big Belly Brothers BBQ, Billy's Gourmet Hot Dogs, and Cluck Shack Chicken, with options for dietary preferences such as gluten-friendly and vegetarian. Special offerings include $5 Fan Friendly items and frozen cocktails.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Current official guidance confirms that accessibility arrangements are handled by Ball Arena, but event-specific services may require advance coordination. Contact the venue before purchasing if you need accessible seating, mobility assistance, interpreting, assistive-listening support, or another accommodation.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Ball Arena's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Ball Arena. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Ball Arena. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
